preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= N for i in range(N)) and len(set(A)) == N
preconditions.description: Array A must contain N distinct integers from 1 to N.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= P[i] <= N for i in range(N)) and len(set(P)) == N

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N and 1 <= y <= N and x != y for x, y in operations if operations[0] == 2)

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N for x in operations if operations[0] == 3)
preconditions.description: For type 3 operations, x must be an integer within the range of 1 to N.

postconditions.description: For each type 3 operation, the output must be the element at position x in array A after all preceding operations.
